comments.body: The Map is wrong, the right location is Egypt North Cost, go all the way south there are Human Remains, the Mamluk Soldier is a little bit east of there.

comments.body: According to Charts info, Mamluk Soldier can be found in Shore Opposite Cairo zone as well. It may be easier to find in Egypt North Coast as you said, though. Thanks; cheers.
